results.name: S1 the Security page reads the backend: GET /admin/security/summary and GET /admin/security-events with the admin token
S2 the counters are the backend's numbers (failed admin sign-ins 24h, failed sign-ins, wrong codes, blocked accounts, permission changes, admin MFA)
S3 the event list is the backend's, newest first, 15 per page, with its total; the top row is this sign-in
S4 the sample events of the mock screen are gone (no seeded "Lockout" / "Rate limit" rows) and the page says what an event never contains
A11Y axe (security page (backend)) no serious / critical violations
S5 "Failures only" is applied by the backend (outcome=failed): only failed sign-ins and wrong codes remain
S6 the wrong admin password of this run is listed: Sign-in failed, the account by name, the reason — and not the password
S7 the wrong customer code is listed without the phone number or the code
S8 the detail shows severity, account, IP address, device, request id and the recorded details
S9 the account-type filter is applied by the backend (filter[principal_type]=customer)
S10 the event filter offers the event types present in the backend and filters there (filter[event]=LOGIN_FAILED)
S11 a date range is applied by the backend; nothing before 2020 → the empty state
S12 the API response contains no password, code, token, phone number, e-mail, identifier hash or internal id
P1 an administrator without the security permission: access denied on screen, 403 from both endpoints
P2 without a token the API answers 401
R1 security page at 390 px: no horizontal page overflow
Z no uncaught page errors or console errors
